summary: A lost election is written as a single plain sentence, no excuse and no comment.
realLife: Young recorded his own loss for county clerk in one short sentence among crop and meeting notes.
sources: Kansas Historical Quarterly, A Hoosier in Kansas: the diary of Hiram H. Young, 1893: https://www.kansashistory.gov/p/a-hoosier-in-kansas-the-diary-of-hiram-h-young-4/13049
inGame: `event:election-result` with the player as the loser: office from `lost-office`, `lost-year` from the filing record.
